strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: kwɛɔ keybox ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ kɛ Google ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ mli lɛ mli (CRL) ni ekaa jɛɛhei srɔtoi ekwɛɔ kɛyashi enaa keybox ni sa, kɛ otomatik sɛɛfimɔ kɛ Google nitsumɔi lɛ shishijee ekoŋŋ. Etsuɔ nii yɛ tap fɛɛ tap nɔ ni ehe hiaa intanɛt (minitii 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox kɛjɛ network nɔ: ejieɔ keybox ko kɛjɛɔ official repository (GitHub) lɛ mli ni ekɛtoɔ /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Ehe miihia intanɛt ni ekɛ minitii 1-3 tsuɔ nii. Akɛtsuɔ nii be mli ni smart fetch lɛ nyɛɛɛ atsu nii loo be mli ni akɛ niji tsake keybox lɛ.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP helatsamɔ: kwɛɔ Remote Key Provisioning modules ni yɔɔ lɛ, ekwɛɔ TEE odaseyeli wolo lɛ henɔ lɛ mli, ni etsɔɔ KmInstallKeybox dɛŋdade lɛ shihilɛ. Tsakeee nɔ ko — tsɔne shihilɛ kwɛmɔ.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine kwɛmɔ (kanemɔ pɛ): tsɔɔ Widevine ŋwɛi gbɛhe nibii (L1/L3) kɛjɛ dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-fail ni yɔɔ, kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ mli nibii ni kɔɔ he. Etsakeee nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Wolo RKP saamɔ: tsuɔ sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh wolo lɛ he nii. Saa odaseyeli saji kɛji otomatik pas lɛ nyɛɛɛ atsu nii. Foidamɔ fɛɛ foidamɔ kalaa omanyeyeli/kunimyeli line ni yɔɔ faŋŋ.
strings.mdRkpFull: • RKP ni eyi obɔ: efoɔ sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ni eyi obɔ. Etsuɔ saji ni wa lɛ ahe nii ni ekɛ be babaoo tsuɔ nii. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ni yɔɔ faŋŋ jeɔ kpo yɛ naagbee.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Okɛ GMS lɛ ato ekoŋŋ: ejieɔ Play Store kɛ Google nitsumɔi (GMS+GSF) lɛ ahe saji ni ekɛ tsɔne lɛ jeɔ shishi ekoŋŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Kɛha odaseyeli ni mli wa pɛ — etaaa omfoniri loo faili he kɔkɔɔkɔ.
strings.mdCertify: • Shwɛmɔ he odaseyeli: kwɛɔ RKP odaseyeli he odaseyeli shihilɛ ni yɔɔ tsɔne lɛ mli lɛ mli ni ekɛ odaseyeli nibii lɛ toɔ ekoŋŋ kɛ ehe miihia. Etaaa mɔ ni kɛtsuɔ nii lɛ data he.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER saamɔ: saa Google nitsumɔi ahe gbɛjianɔtoo (SOTER) saji ni kɔɔ tsɔne he odaseyeli he lɛ. Akɛtsuɔ nii kɛhaa nibii komɛi ni kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ SOTER nɔ moŋ fe Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Okɛ PIF atsu nii: etsuɔ ​​sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh hewalɛ he nii. Kɛ nineshi okadi ni ahala lɛ tsuɔ nii (maŋ/hiɛyaa) ni ekɛ pif.prop/pif.json faili lɛ tsakeɔ. Nɔ ni jɛ mli ba ni yɔɔ faŋŋ jeɔ kpo yɛ wolo lɛ mli.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF kwɛmɔ: tsɔɔ tsɔne ni akɛwo mli lɛ shihilɛ, nineshi nibii (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kɛ woji ni aŋmalaa lɛ. Kwɛmɔ pɛ — etsakeee nɔ ko nɔ ko.
strings.mdCanary: • Kanari tsakemɔ: efoɔ sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ekɛ Canary Engine ni ajie lɛ kpo ehee lɛ ba koni ekwɛ akɛ ekɛ RKP woji ni esa akɛ afee lɛ kpãa gbee (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine lɛ mlikwɛmɔ: ekwɛɔ TrickyStoreOSS shihilɛ (pid, logs), saji adeka lɛ mli faili (ni tsuɔ nii kɛ mɔ ni kɛtsuɔ nii), tsɔne lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ nɔ ni afee lɛ amale lɛ nineshi okadi, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP saji lɛ. Hela taomɔ kpojiemɔ pɛ.

• Ekɛ Canary nineshi okadi hee ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ baa kɛjɛɔ Google.
• Ekɛ shweshweeshwefeemɔ he nibii lɛ feɔ ekome + ejeɔ Google nitsumɔi lɛ shishi ekoŋŋ (akɛtsuuu nii).

⚠️ Min 1). Tsanɔ?
